Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 9734 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-04–2026-06), queried against Lewisham's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 3.641 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (145% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 18.4957 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (152% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 217,424 (2021 resident population of 300,600, scaled by a measured resident-vs-workday ratio from the ONS's 2011 Census release for Lewisham — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.

Frequently asked questions

Is Lewisham safe?

Based on real, current UK Police data, Wandroz rates Lewisham as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered during the day and an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered at night, relative to the other London boroughs currently on the automated pipeline. The rating comes from 9734 recorded incidents over 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06), split into a day-weighted score (property crime) and a night-weighted score (violence, robbery, antisocial behaviour).

Is Lewisham safe at night?

Lewisham's night score is an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered, based on the categories most relevant after dark (violence, robbery, street theft, public order, antisocial behaviour), normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population rather than plain residents where that data exists, so busy central boroughs aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents.

What official data is Lewisham's rating based on?

9734 recorded incidents from data.police.uk (the UK Police's official open crime API), queried against Lewisham's real administrative boundary and covering 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06) — refreshed automatically every month, not a one-off snapshot. Full category breakdown is shown further down this page.
